positiveAlignments.MCCHEAM111: Partial relationship: UCR teaches Western painting and visual interpretation, while VU analyses images and objects across media, art, design and architecture.
positiveAlignments.MCCHEAM212: Partial period relationship: Renaissance painting/sculpture/architecture and global exchange; not VU’s full early-modern four-field survey.
positiveAlignments.MCCHEAM312: Partial exhibition relationship: UCR modern art, curatorial practices and museums intersect VU exhibition history/theory, whose wider design, architecture, festival and political mediation remain different.
positiveAlignments.MCCHEAM316: Partial historiographic relationship: UCR examines art history’s theories and disciplinary construction; VU explicitly integrates four fields.
positiveAlignments.MCCHEAM211: Partial contested-heritage relationship through African collections, colonial looting and repatriation. VU additionally teaches UNESCO World Heritage designations, policy, landscapes and critical management frameworks.
positiveAlignments.MCCMEDI111: Partial film/media-history relationship: UCR film form, cinema history and wider media introduction; VU traces visual mass-media production/distribution/exhibition and media historiography from the nineteenth century.
positiveAlignments.MCCMEDI211: Partial media-analysis relationship: UCR American mainstream screens and storytelling/representation; VU teaches a broader formalism, ideology, participatory-culture and research-methodology framework.
